antithesis: We can conclude that transcranial 870nm at 345 THz with low irradiance 22.2 mW/cm2 for 40 minutes is the most effective strategy validated by the 2024 paper showing wound healing +22%
synthesis: I believe that exposing keratinocytes to 980nm light at 306 THz could repair mitochondrial damage in PDH complex
conclusion: But prolonged exposure at 980nm might generate too much heat and damage surrounding tissue in keratinocytes
